text: The gate in the fence is chained shut.

pickups.ask: Maxine's spare sidearm, in the glovebox. Take it?
taken: Fifteen rounds. You fumble the magazine twice before it clicks in.

pickups.ask: Bolt cutters in the back of the water department van. Take them?
Maxine's keys, still clipped to her vest. Take them?
Spare magazines in her vest pouches. Take them?
A first aid spray on the crates. Take it?
Somebody left a box of 9mm on the dumpster lid. Take it?

taken: Spilled from a cruiser's trunk. Someone else was reloading here.

text: The SUV. Paul's keeping the engine running.
A truck on its side across the whole street, and a car burning under it.
No way through.
RACCOON CITY WATER DEPT. The back doors hang open.
There's space in here to stash things. Nobody's coming back for this van.
Tools are by the open rear doors. Check beside the storage box.
A chain-link fence, the gate chained shut. There's blood on the snow on the other side.

use.ask: Cut the chain with the BOLT CUTTERS?

say: The chain snaps and slithers into the snow.

text: A manhole cover.

examine.ask: Pry up the manhole cover and climb down?

text: The SUV's cargo hatch. Locked.

use.ask: Open the cargo hatch with the SUV KEYS?

say: Gun cases, most of them empty. A box of 9mm and a medical kit.
Got 12 HANDGUN BULLETS and a GREEN HERB. There's a clipboard, too.

text: The driver's door is hanging open. Blood on the seat, the wheel, the dash.
Paul's gone.
The cargo hatch is open. Empty gun cases. Nothing else worth taking.

say: Someone is kneeling over a body in the snow. Eating.

text: Maxine. Oh no. Oh, no no no.

say: The road's blocked by a crash. Fire, and a truck on its side. The SUV idles in the snow.

text: That cooler. You understand what's in it? B7 isn't medicine. It's the neutralizer.
There's a lab on the twenty-eighth floor of Raccoon City General. Tower B.
We get B7 up there, they can make enough of it to stop... all of this.
All of this is you guys, isn't it.
I'm a regional compliance officer. I do paperwork.
Road's done. I'll find us a way around through the alleys. Stay with the car.
Can I at least have a gun?
...Glovebox.

say: Gunshots, somewhere behind the buildings. Then a scream. Then nothing.
Two shapes are climbing over the burning wreck.

text: That was her. Go! Go get her! I'll... watch the car.

say: The SUV's door is open. The engine's off. Paul is gone.
Blood on the driver's seat, and drag marks in the snow.
Something big is coming around the crash. On too many legs.

text: It followed me. It followed me all the way here.
The manhole. Down. Go, go, go!
You drag the cover back over the hole above you.
Something heavy walks across it, and stops.
Then it moves on.
